subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `PluginHookAgentContext` expose a deferred current-session reset method, and if so, should it be restricted to `after_compaction` contexts?
rationale: This adds a permanent plugin API with session-state authority; source review can validate mechanics, but it cannot choose the supported hook scope or long-term contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve after-compaction only
options.body: Expose `resetSession(reason?)` only to `after_compaction` and drain it after every compaction phase has exited, minimizing capability and lifecycle ambiguity.

options.title: Approve generic embedded hooks
options.body: Allow the method on broader embedded hook contexts, with explicit semantics and tests for each hook phase that can enqueue a reset.

options.title: Keep reset orchestration internal
options.body: Do not add a hook API; keep fresh-session decisions inside the context-engine or compaction owner and close this implementation direction.

recommendation.title: Approve after-compaction only
recommendation.body: Expose `resetSession(reason?)` only to `after_compaction` and drain it after every compaction phase has exited, minimizing capability and lifecycle ambiguity.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected ordering boundary is owned by the context-engine and native follow-up compaction lifecycle introduced in their recent work.
